direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh at 1366x768, overflow hidden; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; compact horizontal rail only with equal-width non-wrapping targets at least 36px, aria-current and arrow-key movement; independent reserved zones for rendered scene, callouts, stations and jobs with no overlap; rendered scene fills at least 70% of main; side content condensed inside its reserved zone without inspector scrolling
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald green and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary text; emerald/neon #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stopped states use silver cross-hatching, an x cross marker and plain OFFLINE text, never red; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px; large header tabs spanning most of the header with labels at least 16px; 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration
direction.motion: Living material flow, state glow, depth and cinematic transitions driven by real state; 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change then static; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions and flow while silver pattern, cross marker and OFFLINE text carry meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second required logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; side zone keeps connection readiness checks for provider identity separate from the investigation evidence task under separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre, one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then an Authorize this decision wall; a pending task proposal is deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan can coexist while replacement tasks await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite for results
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in emerald, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 in silver cross-hatching with x marker and plain OFFLINE text and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text; depth via layered silver machine bodies, emerald state glow on active routes, and living flow dashes that freeze under reduced motion

fixes.change: Enlarge the factory scene within its reserved zone so the stations and jobs read larger at 1366x768 while keeping callouts and evidence in separate zones.
Raise side-zone secondary text to 16px body where space allows and keep source values tabular for instant 120 versus 80 comparison.
Add stronger emerald state glow and depth on the held material flow, frozen under reduced motion.
Make the separate headings for provider identity readiness check and investigation evidence task visually distinct in the side zone so their status and controls cannot be conflated.
Give the Verified findings panel more visual hierarchy with a clear emerald count row and keep the full side zone visible without scrolling.
Strengthen bidirectional highlighting so selecting Certificate, Receiving or Substitute in the side zone lights the matching scene track.
Keep the three path selectors at least 44px tall with clear selected focus ring, since selecting one must open the one-click Approve then Authorize this decision wall.
Enlarge the scene slightly and align the DOES NOT MATCH label fully inside stage bounds.
Add a subtle cinematic glow only to the feasible path cards to guide comparison without looping motion.
Make the PROPOSED and UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL state unmistakable on all three task cards with dashed silver borders in addition to the emerald active card.
Increase task title contrast and keep due times tabular so the board scans in seconds.
Add depth and a single state-glow trace from the accepted plan into task 01 on entry, static thereafter.
Ensure the preview banner plainly pairs cross-hatching, x marker and OFFLINE wording so the shock reads without color alone.
Keep the invalidating-action status in the action bar at 16px and announce it via aria-live.
Intensify the emerald recovery-flow glow on CELL-MILL-1 and jobs while the offline preview stays silver.
Keep provider identity readiness and investigation evidence as separate side-zone blocks; the cleared findings state should sit only under the investigation heading.
Make the constrained Split option clearly unavailable with cross-hatching, x marker and plain text in both scene and side zones.
Restore findings panel affordance so its collapsed state still shows a 36px target and expected result.
Label the constrained path as unavailable rather than selectable and remove its pointer style while keeping its tradeoff area visible.
Keep PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED in the action bar prominent and paired with the Review revised option primary.
Add a one-time 240ms route trace showing feasible routes bypassing the offline cell, then static.
Hold the coexistence message in one line: blocked prior tasks, approved plan retained, proposed replacements untracked until approval.
Give CELL-MILL-2 full silver cross-hatching, x marker and plain OFFLINE text at scene scale for instant recognition.
Add gentle depth separation between station row and task row so the board reads as a live floor plan.
Keep the three proof stages equal height with READY, LOCKED and LOCKED legible at a glance and the dashed chain aligned.
Make the passphrase guidance 16px and keep its field and locked downstream controls inside the reserved side zone without scrolling.
Add emerald glow only to stage 01 and the Verify ledger primary to focus the single next action.
Fix clipped OFFLINE labels at department footers so full text and counts render inside each panel at 1366x768.
Increase machine and department label contrast and enlarge the emerald mills to lathes route so the cascade reads across the full shop.
Reduce cross-hatching dominance on non-offline departments and reserve the pattern mainly for stopped areas, keeping silver machine depth and living flow on the feasible path.
Enlarge the full-shop cascade visual or its caption type so the three signals in the caption are legible without zooming.
Make the Live demo link a larger target with a clear focus ring while preserving the required presentation order.
Tighten the hero visual crop so the headline and three control promises stay fully visible above the cascade.
